name: claude-roadmap-tools
description: Standalone Claude Code plugin: ROADMAP / IN_PROGRESS / HISTORY tracking flow with /create-roadmap, /adopt-roadmap and /migrate-roadmap. Supports four backends — files (markdown at the repo root), linear (via the Linear MCP), github-project (GitHub Projects v2 via the GitHub MCP), and github-issues (one GitHub Issue per task via the gh CLI) — with an optional offline mirror.
